# Needs to see the target before building; text-only build specs don't work for 3D

After Lesson 10 he said he likes the custom builds (chest) on top of the video, but finds it very hard to picture what he's supposed to create from written instructions alone. That's expected for a beginner in a visual skill: text forces him to hold a mental 3D model in working memory while also learning new tools.

**Evidence**: His own report on L10's chest task.

**Implications**: Every build task now comes with rendered images of the finished result and of each step, generated by Blender in background mode (assets/tools/blender_render.py), so they look like his Solid viewport. Captions map to checklist steps. Images are a worked example of the *outcome*. The steps still make him do the work, so it stays effortful.
